message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: two defendants beat victim, victim died due to acute coronary attack triggered by fight, also had nasal bone fractures (light injury). The prosecution says "故意伤害他人身体致人死亡" i.e., intentional injury causing death. In Chinese criminal law, that is "故意伤害致死罪" (intentional injury resulting in death) which is a form of intentional injury (故意伤害罪) with death result, often called "故意伤害致死". So final answer: [罪名]故意伤害<eoa>
